PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (19.0, 14.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion, efficiency)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # input pair L (gain via VA)
    "gmid3": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "L3":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror L (gain vs mirror pole)
    "Itail": (7.8e-6, 6.0e-6, 8.2e-6),
    "gmidt": (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),       # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # tail L (CMRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]
    Ih = It / 2

    # bias: diode sinking IREF, tail mirrors it (same L, same gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=0.6)
    vtail = 0.9 - m1.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], It, vds=max(vtail, 0.15))
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ih, vds=0.0 + 1.0)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ih, vds=m3.vgs)
    vout_dc = vdd - m3.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=max(vout_dc - vtail, 0.2))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp on diode side -> non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cpar = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd
    ctot = cl + cpar
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fmir)) / 2   # pole-zero doublet ~ halves the effect
    sr = It / ctot
    # CMRR ~ Ad * 2*gm3/gds_tail
    cmrr = a0 * 2 * m3.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-12)
    psrr = a0 * 0.9
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300
    th = 2 * 4 * kT * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(th) * 2.5   # allow flicker contribution at 1 kHz (long-L devices)
    swing_lo = vtail + 0.15
    swing_hi = vdd - 0.15
    step = 0.5
    tslew = max(step - 2 / p["gmid1"], 0) / sr
    settle = tslew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    power = vdd * (iref + It)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "noise_1k": noise,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr), "slew": sr, "power": power,
        "swing": swing_hi - swing_lo, "settle": settle,
        "psrr_db": db(psrr), "polarity": 1,
    }
